summary: Acer Nitro V16 Gaming Laptop has thermal throttling due to limited power limit for the GPU TDP (135W), potentially leading to reduced performance and increased temperatures. Considering hot weather conditions in Mexico, alternative options with better cooling and thermal management are recommended.
detected_fault: Thermal Throttling due to limited power limit for the GPU TDP (135W)
suggested_solution: Consider purchasing a laptop cooler with a foam seal design or undervolting if necessary, and monitor temperatures and performance during use.
